cases.description: All expected mass/water/electricity terms observed with claim-permitting evidence; accepted output, yield and servings reconcile.
One required water stage is unknown; no total water or per-serving water figure is emitted.
One preregistered mass flow is omitted; totals and mass closure are withheld.
A stage explicitly not applicable with a reason is excluded from the total and recorded.
An empty not-applicable justification is invalid.
The arithmetic is complete but simulated evidence prevents a claim-eligible result.
Accounted output mass is greater than total input mass.
A category declared as accepted edible output is incorrectly marked as an input.
Duplicate term IDs or duplicate water/electricity stages are rejected.
Measured evidence without a calibration reference cannot qualify the receipt.
An explicitly measured zero accepted mass with zero accepted servings is retained; no per-serving ratios are emitted.
A positive accepted serving count cannot be paired with zero accepted edible mass.
An overflow while computing mass-balance parts per million is reported; no wrapped ratio is emitted.
